text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан takes first place and the
Spring
Shield is hers!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If I didn't muster all my strength, I
wouldn't
have won.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан! As expected, you were so
cool out
there!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Nice win against Райс Шоуэр! You
looked
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: ...I lost.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: ...Hey.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: E-eek!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Don't listen to any of that racket. No
matter what
people say about you, don't
let your strength
waver.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. You're a nice
person.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: But I'm not going to let it end here.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Because... there are people that I want
to make
happy someday.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан! Do your best in the next
one too!
Don't lose!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан!
Briaaan!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Райс Шоуэр! You can win!
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: Thanks... I'll do my best.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: ...She's strong.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: This means we've got to get stronger too.

text_block_list.text: Exactly.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Raw strength alone doesn't qualify
someone to
stand where we're standing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We need to keep climbing... to the very
top of
the world.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
From now on, the top means the fierce
races of
the Senior Autumn Triple
Crown, a whole
different level from the
Classic Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The top races in the senior year are the
autumn
Tenno Sho, the Japan
Cup—where the world's
fiercest
compete—and the Arima Kinen, the

year-end Grand Prix.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
How does the Senior Autumn Triple Crown
sound?

text_block_list.text:
...If that's where the strength I'm
searching for is,
just say the word.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And so, we set our sights on the Senior
Autumn
Triple Crown's first battle—the
autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
